description: Verify behavior when either the Pallium service or the Codex App Server restarts mid-delivery.

scenarios.name: pallium_restarts_before_trigger
scenarios.expected_recovery: dispatcher re-reads queued rows, re-triggers with same clientUserMessageId

scenarios.name: pallium_restarts_while_triggered
scenarios.expected_recovery: outstanding triggered deliveries recovered; if within deadline, await callback

scenarios.name: already_admitted_recovery
scenarios.expected_recovery: delivery already complete; idempotent — no second wake attempt
